title: Daniel Gockerell triangle sighting

tellings.quote: You never got to hear Daniel Gockerell. Small story, but I had him on Weaponized After. He saw a a triangle.

plain: A man named Daniel Gockerell says he saw a triangle-shaped object in the sky. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell, who makes documentaries about UFOs, mentions it to Michels as a small story. He passes it on from Gockerell, who told it as a guest on Corbell's own show, Weaponized, and he gives no time or place for the sighting.
